answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 19748 Country: India Title: chartered accountant course or job in the light of quran and hadees? Question: chartered accountant course or job in the light of quran and hadeese Answer ID: 19748 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 344/270/B=1431) Doing chartered accountant course is lawful and doing a job as chartered accountant is lawful as well, provided the job is not of a bank or such an institute where interest based dealing is made. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
